description: Submits an enquiry for one of the seven lines of business, or a general enquiry. Required: line, company, country, name of the contact person, company e-mail address and a summary of the requirement. The enquiry is checked and screened for prohibited uses and sanctioned regions; enquiries within scope are followed up by an engineer. The result is an acknowledgement, not an offer or quotation.

email.description: Company e-mail address of the contact person

lang.description: Language of the result: en (English, the default) or zh (Chinese).

line.description: Line of business concerned, or general

scope.description: Optional: scope of supply or services

name: submit_enquiry
title: Submit an enquiry
